title: Remote viewing God as a target

tellings.quote: >> And when I came out of the session and they opened the envelope, it said, "God."

plain: Lyn Buchanan, a former Army sergeant who worked in a military remote viewing unit in the 1980s, says he was once given a target that turned out to be God. Remote viewing is the claimed ability to describe a hidden target with the mind alone, and the targets were sealed in envelopes. Buchanan tells Michels that he did the session himself, and that when he came out of it and the envelope was opened, 'it said, God.'
